item.title: Version 0.8.8
item.description:
What's New

  • Pro: scenes with Wallpaper Engine user shortcuts get a row for each shortcut in their settings — bind a website, an Apple Shortcut, a file, a folder or an app
  • Pro: clicks on the desktop and on desktop icons reach the scene, so its buttons can run their shortcuts while the wallpaper stays click-through
  • Pro: shortcut icon slots in a scene show the icon of the bound item
  • Pro: more Wallpaper Engine scene scripts work — scripts can show and hide effects and change their settings, and keyframed scale and rotation animate

Improvements

  • Pro: scene Interaction is on by default — only a scene's clickable objects take clicks, the rest of the desktop works as usual
  • Pro: with Interaction off, desktop clicks no longer reach the scene
  • Pro: the Workshop downloads sheet says what is missing and offers Connect Steam; the subscription check can choose the Steam library folder again

Bug Fixes

  • Pro: scenes whose image shaders use the layer color no longer render black
  • Pro: object brightness, particle tint and particle transparency match Wallpaper Engine
  • Pro: image layers with a normal map no longer turn partly transparent
  • Pro: outline effects and some other shaders compile again

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen.app" once; updates Loomscreen installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
